title: Basic character of amines
notes: **Scope.** Basic character of amines — Amines, Chemistry (class-12-notes).
**Tested.** define it · list: basic character of amines · one worked example · one misconception each.
**Fact.** Amines: RNH₂ (1°), R₂NH (2°), R₃N (3°), R₄N⁺ (quaternary). Basicity: lone pair on N; resonance + EWG lower it.
**Fact.** Aryl amines are weakly basic (lone pair delocalised into ring); alkyl are more basic; aniline pKb ≈ 9.4.
**Fact.** Reaction: with HNO₂ — 1° aliphatic (N₂⁺ → alcohol), aromatic (diazonium, diazo-chemistry).
